quotes.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: No man is free who is not master of himself.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a great deal of it.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: He who is brave is free.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Well begun is half done.
quotes.author: Aristotle

quotes.text: Confine yourself to the present.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.text: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Opportunities multiply as they are seized.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.text: In the midst of chaos, there is also opportunity.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu

quotes.text: No great thing is created suddenly.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
quotes.author: Oliver Goldsmith
quotes.source: The Citizen of the World, Letter VII (1760)

quotes.text: True magnanimity consists not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
quotes.author: Oliver Goldsmith
quotes.source: The Citizen of the World, Letter XXII (1760)

quotes.text: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: The greater the difficulty, the more glory in surmounting it.
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
quotes.author: Japanese proverb

quotes.text: No man is more unhappy than he who never faces adversity, for he is not permitted to prove himself.
quotes.author: Seneca
